what_this_is: A hand-written snapshot of the LexChat build this gather ran against. The harness does not inspect the server's build, so this file is the only record of it, and it is a claim by whoever wrote it rather than something measured.
lexchat_commit_subject: Merge fix/prepilot-defects into main: second cut of the pre-pilot defect fixes (Session 22, 30 of 48 rows, 8 of 14 buckets)

observed_at_capture.note: Read from GET /api/models and GET /api/developer/provider-config at gather time, so these two are measured rather than asserted.

verified_against_this_build: Audit event emits schema_version 5; the harness accepts 1 to 5.
get_legislation_changes is live and called by the Worker.
search_legislation returns leading JSON with results[].legislation_id, plus the new returned/total_matched/removed_by_filters keys.
Worker reports carry an appended [SEARCH SCOPE] instruction block, about half the report by length.
unknown: Whether the running server is built from this commit. The commit is read from the local LexChat/ clone, which is not evidence of the deployed build.
